data.name: Outrigger Canoe Surfing
data.headline: 20-60 Minutes •  Ages 5+ •“Hoe Ka Wa'a!" (Paddle the Canoe!)
data.description: Experience the thrill of canoe surfing, Hawaiʻi’s original roller coaster ride. Paddle out to the surf break with our certified canoe captains, then catch a wave back to shore in a traditional outrigger canoe.
data.highlights:
- Surf waves in a traditional Hawaiian outrigger canoe
- Guided by certified canoe captains
- Perfect for all swimming and paddling abilities
- Fun for families with children aged 5+
data.itinerary:
- Paddle out to the surfbreak under the guidance of your experienced Waikīkī Beachboy canoe captains.
- Catch three waves in an outrigger canoe
- Experience the thrill of surfing a wave

meeting_point.address: Royal Hawaiian Hotel, 2259 Kalākaua Ave., Honolulu, HI 96815

data.what_is_included:
- Canoe and paddles
- Certified canoe captains to guide and assist
data.what_is_not_included:
- Lifejackets (available upon request for adults)
- Personal flotation devices (required for children, must be provided by guardian)
-Towels
-Reef safe sunscreen
-Lockers for personal items
data.what_to_bring:
- Towel
- Reef safe sunscreen
- Flotation device for children (if required)

If you wish to change or cancel your booking, please submit your request via e-mail to info@waikikibeachservices.com at least 48 hours before an activity/rental. No-shows or cancellation requests received within 48 hours will not be eligible for refund.

Please allow up to 10 business days for refunds to process between banking institutions.

data.health_and_safety_notes:
Your safety and the safety of our staff are our highest priorities. All participants, including minors, must complete an electronic liability waiver before participating in any Waikīkī Beach Services activity or rental. A link to the waiver will be included in your confirmation email. We recommend completing all waivers before your scheduled activity to help expedite check-in.

Some activities and rentals have minimum age requirements. Please provide accurate participant ages when booking. Guests who do not meet the age requirement or appear to be under the influence of drugs or alcohol will not be permitted to participate, and no refund will be issued.

Please do not leave personal belongings unattended on the beach or at the pool. Limited storage is available for shoes and towels, but valuables should be left in a secure location. Waikīkī Beach Services and its staff are not responsible for lost, stolen, or damaged personal property.
data.disclaimers: In case of large surf or unpredictable conditions, tours may be rescheduled or canceled.
data.faqs:
**Can children participate?** Yes, children aged 5+ are welcome with a guardian who must hold them during the ride.

**I cannot swim, but can I participte?** Yes, non-swimers are welcome.

**There are only two of us (or I'm traveling alone.)  How can I book?  Can you put me with other guests?** Yes, As long as you book for the minimum of 3, we'll add our staff to help you paddle.  Please kindly note the total number of guest in your party.  Unfortunately, all the bookings are exclusive; we do not mix the strangers.

**What is the difference between "Canoe Surfing" and "Canoe Charter?"** Canoe surfing requires a minimum of 3 participants, with a maximum of 6 participants. During your canoe surfing experience you will catch and ride three waves. Canoe Surfing is private to your group. Guests do not join other parties and are never placed with another group. If a party has fewer than 3 people, WBS staff fill the open paddling seats.

A canoe charter is available for one to six participants. During a charter, you can enjoy as many wave rides as conditions allow.

**What happens if the surf is too large?** Safety is our priority. In cases of large surf or unpredictable ocean conditions, we may cancel or reschedule the booking.  Please wait to hear from us to make any decisions.

**My party is more than 6 people.  What would be the best way to book?** Please contact us at info@waikikibeachservices.com so that we can provide you the best itinerary.

**Who can paddle or become just a rider?** When the canoe is filled with the maximum of 6 participants: 4 people will be the paddlers and 2 people will be the riders.  All healthy individuals can be the paddlers as long as they are 13 and older.
